blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A think tank has called on the government to invest in the country’s telecommunications sector, as it pursues an artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure masterplan for 2026 to 2033. Stratbase Institute President Prof. Victor Andres “Dindo” Manhit on Wednesday urged the government to expedite nationwide connectivity and telecommunications deployment, primarily as it seeks to make the country an AI-powered and digitally competitive economy. He said that the Philippines AI+ Infrastructure Master Plan 2026-2033 signals a need for a “more aggressive telecommunications infrastructure development.” “Government has ambitious plans to harness artificial intelligence, digitalize public services and attract technology-intensive industries.
